messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Ask your doctor before taking buspirone with a sleeping pill, narcotic pain medicine, muscle relaxer, or medicine for anxiety, depression, or seizures.
Other drugs may interact with buspirone.
These include prescription and over-the-counter medicines.
These also include vitamins and herbal products.
Tell each of your health care providers about all medicines you use now and any medicine you start or stop using.

The relation 'may interact with' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug could potentially interact with the substance or medication specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
B. 'similar to': The subject drug is related to or an alternative for the drug specified by the object entity.
C. 'has use indication': The subject drug may be used for the medical purpose or indication specified by the object entity.
D. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
